task_description: Update the existing message-processor Lambda into a LangGraph agent served as a FastAPI app on AWS Lambda, callable BOTH via an HTTP Lambda Function URL (Mangum) AND via SQS (WhatsApp inbound), sharing one run_agent core. LLM is Amazon Bedrock via langchain-aws ChatBedrockConverse (no Bedrock Agents). HITL interrupt before create_order, resumed across stateless invocations by a custom DynamoDB-backed checkpointer. Four DynamoDB tables (users, chat history, checkpointer w/ 7-day TTL, conversation->workflow mapping). conversation_id threads through interrupt/resume, into create_order and the order API body, and back via POST /callback. Leave handler.py and whatsapp_lambda.py untouched; reuse whatsapp_lambda helpers. Target Python 3.12.
